badge.description: Compact label for category, metadata, or semantic status. Categorical colors and warning/danger statuses are distinct.
badge.variant: Visual style. Solid uses a tinted background; dot shows a colored indicator.
badge.color: Categorical color: gray, red, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, emerald, teal, cyan, blue, indigo, violet, purple, fuchsia, pink, rose.
badge.statusDescription: Semantic product status. Unlike `color`, it uses the warning or danger status tokens and exposes status semantics.
